trans.sense: Any of various wading birds of the genera Egretta or Ardea

examples.text: Egrets picked their way through the grass, attentive and showy as fussy girlfriends at the cows' sides.

glosses: Any of various wading birds of the genera Egretta or Ardea that includes herons, many of which are white or buff, and several of which develop fine plumes during the breeding season.
A plume or tuft of feathers worn as a part of a headdress, or anything imitating such an ornament.

examples.text: The student has made egregious errors on the examination.

I cannot cross my arms, or sigh "Ah me," / "Ah me forlorn!" egregious foppery! / I cannot buss thy fill, play with thy hair, / Swearing by Jove, "Thou art most debonnaire!"
My lord, you give me most egregious indignity.
